scope: Portfolio help expanded at five widths, visible/schema text parity and unchanged guest holdings. Only named FAQ controls/own analytics preference used; no reset/data-clearing or account/order/contact submission.

rows.question: How do I reset my virtual portfolio?
rows.answer: Guest records are browser-held; clearing site data removes the local copy. Signed-in cash, positions and server-recorded trades can restore from the account copy when the service is available. Clearing browser data does not delete or reset that account copy. Earlier guest history, journals and course progress remain browser-held.
